articles.summary: NVIDIA is in Europe, showcasing the future of technology together with the region’s developers, researchers and industry leaders.
articles.fullSummary: Monday, Oct 12, 10:00 pm PDT Nat Ives From Earth to Orbit, France’s Ecosystem Delivers Agentic Computing at Scale With NVIDIA Companies in France are deploying agentic computing across industries spanning space, financial services, the public sector and scientific research, demonstrating how the country’s ecosystem has moved from ambition to application. France’s progress sits on deliberate groundwork. The AI Action Summit in February 2025 and Choose France Summits in 2025 and 2026 anchored major compute commitments on French soil. What the ecosystem has built since then spans the full stack.
